title: Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Claims Manual: One Deductible per Occurrence
content:
**Rule.** When two or more vehicles on the same policy are damaged in one occurrence (their claims share the same occurrence reference) and the deductible option provides one deductible per occurrence, only one deductible is applied to the occurrence: the highest deductible among the accepted claims, taken from the claim with the highest deductible. The other claims of the occurrence record a deductible of 0.00. Under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage every deductible option provides one deductible per occurrence.

Deductible Rewards credit is held per vehicle and can be used only on a claim of the vehicle that earned it. Loss paid is tracked per vehicle and never pooled.

## What decides the occurrence

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Same occurrence | The claims carry the same occurrence reference |
| Same policy | The damaged vehicles are scheduled on the same auto policy |
| Deductible applied | The highest deductible among the occurrence's accepted claims, on the claim that carries it |
| Every other claim of the occurrence | Records 0.00 |

## Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

Two vehicles on one policy are damaged by the same falling tree and their claims share one occurrence reference. The accepted claim on the first vehicle carries a deductible of 500.00 and the accepted claim on the second carries 1000.00.

- The occurrence takes one deductible, the highest: 1000.00, on the second vehicle's claim.
- The first vehicle's claim records 0.00.
- If the first vehicle holds Deductible Rewards credit, that credit stays with the first vehicle; it is never moved onto the second vehicle's claim.
- Amounts paid on each claim count toward the loss paid of the vehicle that was paid, separately for each vehicle.

## Scope note

A claim that does not share its occurrence reference with another vehicle's claim on the same policy is outside this rule.
